theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 7 群

items.colloc: tourist attraction 觀光景點 | main attraction 主要賣點
items.distinct: attract v. 吸引 | attractive adj. 有吸引力的
ex: The new park is a major tourist attraction.
這座新公園是一個主要的觀光景點。
We discussed the attraction of this product line.
我們討論了這個產品系列的吸引力。
High salaries are an attraction for job seekers.
高薪對於求職者來說具有吸引力。

items.colloc: target audience 目標受眾 | reach an audience 接觸觀眾
items.distinct: viewer 觀看電視者 | spectator 體育賽事觀眾
ex: The speaker addressed a large audience today.
講者今天向一大群聽眾發表演說。
Our target audience is young professionals.
我們的目標受眾是年輕的專業人士。
The audience responded well to the presentation.
觀眾對這次簡報的反應很好。

items.colloc: calculate the cost 計算成本 | calculate the risk 評估風險
items.distinct: compute 運算 | estimate 估計
ex: Please calculate the total cost for the order.
請計算這份訂單的總成本。
We need to calculate the projected profits carefully.
我們需要仔細估算預期的利潤。
It is difficult to calculate the exact loss.
計算確切的損失是很困難的。

items.pos: n. 活動；競選 | v. 發起活動
items.colloc: marketing campaign 行銷活動 | launch a campaign 發起活動
items.distinct: project 專案 | event 活動
ex: The company launched a new marketing campaign.
公司發起了一項新的行銷活動。
Our advertising campaign reached many new clients.
我們的廣告活動接觸到了許多新客戶。
They are campaigning for better workplace safety.
他們正在為改善職場安全發起運動。

items.colloc: be careful with 小心處理 | careful planning 謹慎規劃
items.distinct: cautious 謹慎的 | attentive 專注的
ex: Please be careful with the fragile equipment.
請小心處理這些易碎的設備。
Careful planning is essential for project success.
謹慎的規劃對專案成功至關重要。
You should be careful when signing contracts.
簽署合約時你應該要小心。

items.colloc: carefully considered 經過深思熟慮的 | listen carefully 仔細聆聽
items.distinct: cautiously 謹慎地 | thoroughly 徹底地
ex: Read the instructions carefully before starting.
開始之前請仔細閱讀說明。
The manager carefully reviewed the financial report.
經理仔細審閱了財務報告。
Each document must be carefully organized today.
今天每份文件都必須仔細整理。

items.colloc: be certain that 確定... | a certain amount of 一定數量的
items.distinct: sure 確信的 | particular 特定的
ex: I am certain that we will meet the deadline.
我確信我們會趕上截止日期。
There is a certain risk in this investment.
這項投資存在一定的風險。
Make certain the power is off before leaving.
離開前確保電源已關閉。

items.colloc: training certificate 培訓證書 | birth certificate 出生證明
items.distinct: license 執照 | degree 學位
ex: She received a certificate for completing the course.
她獲得了完成該課程的證書。
Please submit your professional certificate by Friday.
請在週五前繳交你的專業證照。
The certificate is valid for three years.
這張證書的有效期為三年。

items.colloc: work closely with 與...密切合作 | watch closely 密切觀察
items.distinct: near 靠近地 | densely 密集地
ex: We work closely with our overseas partners.
我們與海外合作夥伴密切配合。
Please monitor the market trends very closely.
請密切監控市場趨勢。
The two companies are closely related today.
這兩家公司今日聯繫非常緊密。

items.colloc: data collection 資料收集 | fashion collection 時裝系列
items.distinct: selection 精選 | accumulation 累積
ex: Our data collection method needs improvement.
我們的資料收集方法需要改進。
The fall fashion collection is now available.
秋季時裝系列現在已經上市了。
He manages a large collection of art pieces.
他管理著一大批藝術收藏品。

items.colloc: make a commitment 做承諾 | show commitment 展現投入
items.distinct: promise 口頭答應 | dedication 奉獻
ex: We appreciate your commitment to this project.
我們感謝你對這個專案的投入。
They made a commitment to quality service.
他們對優質服務做出了承諾。
Maintaining high standards requires total commitment.
維持高標準需要全力的投入。

items.colloc: local community 當地社區 | business community 商業界
items.distinct: society 社會 | organization 組織
ex: The project benefits the local community greatly.
這個計畫對當地社區助益良多。
We hope to serve the community better soon.
我們希望能盡快更好地服務社群。
The business community is worried about inflation.
商業界對通貨膨脹感到擔憂。

items.pos: n. 衝突；爭執 | v. 衝突
items.colloc: resolve a conflict 解決衝突 | schedule conflict 時間安排衝突
items.distinct: disagreement 分歧 | dispute 爭議
ex: There is a conflict in our meeting schedule.
我們的會議行程有衝突。
We need to resolve the conflict peacefully now.
我們現在需要和平地解決衝突。
Personal interests often conflict with professional duties.
個人利益常與專業職責產生衝突。

items.colloc: shipping container 運輸貨櫃 | storage container 儲存容器
items.distinct: box 箱子 | package 包裝
ex: The goods were loaded into a shipping container.
貨物被裝進了運輸貨櫃中。
Please store the chemicals in a sealed container.
請將化學品存放在密封容器內。
This container is designed for long-term storage.
這個容器是為長期儲存而設計的。

items.pos: adj. 關鍵的；批評的；嚴重的
items.colloc: critical role 關鍵角色 | critical thinking 批判性思考
items.distinct: crucial 至關重要的 | serious 嚴重的
ex: Your feedback is critical to our product development.
你的回饋對我們的產品開發至關重要。
The situation has reached a critical stage today.
情況已經到了關鍵階段。
He is very critical of the new proposal.
他對這項新提案持嚴格批評態度。

items.colloc: job description 工作說明 | provide a description 提供描述
items.distinct: definition 定義 | explanation 解釋
ex: Please provide a brief description of the job.
請提供這份工作的簡短描述。
The product description matches what we need.
產品說明書符合我們的需求。
Read the job description before applying online.
線上申請前請先閱讀工作說明。

items.colloc: deserve a chance 值得一個機會 | well deserved 實至名歸的
items.distinct: earn 賺取 | merit 應得
ex: Our hardworking team deserves a long break.
我們勤奮的團隊值得一個長假。
This proposal deserves our full attention today.
這項提案今天值得我們全神關注。
You deserve recognition for your excellent work.
你卓越的工作表現值得被表揚。

items.colloc: discuss the matter 討論此事 | discuss in detail 詳細討論
items.distinct: debate 辯論 | talk about 談論
ex: We need to discuss the budget for next year.
我們需要討論明年的預算。
Let us discuss this issue in the meeting.
我們在會議中討論這個議題吧。
They discussed several options for the expansion.
他們討論了幾個擴張的方案。

items.colloc: dismiss an employee 解僱員工 | dismiss a claim 駁回要求
items.distinct: fire 開除 | reject 拒絕
ex: The manager decided to dismiss the new applicant.
經理決定拒絕這位新申請者。
We cannot simply dismiss these valid concerns.
我們不能輕易摒棄這些合理的擔憂。
The case was dismissed due to lack evidence.
由於缺乏證據，該案被駁回。

items.colloc: distribution center 配送中心 | marketing distribution 行銷通路
items.distinct: allocation 分撥 | delivery 遞送
ex: The new distribution center opens next month.
新的配送中心下個月開幕。
We need to improve our product distribution system.
我們需要改進產品配送系統。
The distribution of resources is being reviewed.
資源的分配情形正在被審查。
